messages:
maria_cs: FYI AvalonEdge asked to onboard a custom 13B summarization model into Private infra. They need PHI-safe summaries, HSM/KMS integration, and low-latency (<250ms) for short requests. Opening thread to align on evals, privacy gating, and rollout plan.

sam_eng: Thanks. Do we have model artifact format? flax/pt/ggml? Also need tokenizer and expected seq length distribution.

maria_cs: They sent a tar with `avalon-13b-fp16.pt` + `tokenizer.json`. Sequence length mostly 128-256, occasional up to 1024 for long clinical notes. Link they provided: https://files.redwood/avalon/avalon-13b-v1.tar

lina_eval: I'll draft a PHI prompt suite and red-teaming checklist. Suggest evals: PHI extraction recall, hallucination rate on clinical notes, paraphrase stability, and leakage tests. ETA tomorrow AM.

rebecca_pm: We should propose Private deployment + HSM integration. Customer asked for an E2E pen test before go-live. FYI renewal is 2025-11 — if onboarding is delayed >8 weeks, renewal risk increases.

mike_sre: :eyes: On HSM/KMS, we'll need their certs and network access details for Private. Can they accept a site-to-site VPN or do they require an air-gapped transfer? Also confirm audit/log retention policy required.

sam_eng: On runtime side, recommend q4_k mixed quant + KV cache enabled. Quick config draft:
```yaml
model: avalon-13b
precision: fp16
quant: q4_k
kv_cache: true
max_seq: 1024
```
Any objections?

lina_eval: No objections. Eval commands I'll run locally and on staging: 
```bash
./eval_runner --model /mnt/models/avalon-13b --prompts evals/phi_suite.json --metrics rouge,exact_match,phi_leakage
```
I'll include baseline vs redwood-13b-1 for regression detection and surface examples for manual review.

maria_cs: Customer requests a per-request redaction step before sending long notes to the model (they want PHI redaction as a preprocessor). Can we insert a redaction prehook in the pipeline?

sam_eng: Yes — we can implement a prehook that calls `redact-service` as a synchronous step. Need to measure the added latency; goal is <50ms overhead for short notes. We'll also add a toggle so they can opt-out for internal testing.

rebecca_pm: Action items: Lina to share the eval plan by EOD, Sam to confirm HSM onboarding steps and draft config, Mike to coordinate VPN/network preshift with infra, Maria to sync a go/no-go with the account next Tue. Flagging: medium renewal risk if timeline slips.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: ONBOARD-8732 — private-deploy avalon-13b. Assigned: sam_eng, lina_eval, mike_sre. ETA: first staging deploy in ~3 weeks.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll send a 30-min sync invite for Thursday to review eval results and next steps.
